title: 第24章 有水喝啦
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
此时夜黑风高，远处海浪声夹杂着风声簌簌作响，时不时还有不知名生物啼叫几声。

    醒神的赵玉兰挨着丈夫近了点，明明脊背发凉偏偏还爱问：“公公说什么了？”

    蔡老太面不改色做激动状：“他说事办好了，叫咱们放宽心，建业，你爸给咱们送水源来了。”

    梦居然还能上下文衔接？此时魏建业也彻底动摇了。

    边上的赵玉兰低声喊道：“肯定是真的，我小时候住的地方离坟场近，有一天我们那有个女的出门走亲戚回来晚了。

    那时候正在下小雨，她一个人撑着伞朝家里走，走着走着不知道什么时候旁边多了个人，浑身裹得严严实实的，脑袋上还别了个布。

    那女的只当对方是挡雨没放在心上，但又怕是坏人所以一直保持着距离。

    然后对方忽然开口说：“大姐，让我进去躲躲雨吧。”

    女的头一句没听见就继续走，余光瞥见那人站原地不动弹，只是还在喊：“大姐，你的伞大，让我进去行吗？”

    那人光说不动，就好像不同意就没法进伞下一样。

    女的感觉不对劲不敢回头也不敢搭话，直到听不见后头脚步声才敢慢慢走。

    那时候雨也下大了，她就躲进路边的草垛里，撑开伞堵着洞口防止雨淋进来。”

    忽然外面又有人说话，还是那一句话，“大姐，让我进去行吗？”

    这时候再傻的人都知道外头不是人，女的就使劲用伞堵住洞口。

    外头那东西还一个劲地想钻进草垛里，开始一遍一遍地重复“行吗，行吗，行吗，行吗……”

    赵玉兰神戳戳地压低声音，“绝对是真事，后来听说要是答应了就得死，不过那女的还大病了一场。”

    可见，世界上就是有很多玄乎事，公公托梦都不算啥了。

    蔡老太顺着儿媳妇的话往下说，“要不咋说人对啥都得有敬畏心，我年轻的时候还碰见过汗毛桩，也叫诈尸，就是已经死了的人都埋了两三天了，扒土自己钻出来了，跟正常人一模一样，就是脑袋后有三根金毛，后来听说是有人拿部队大印给盖死了。”

    小老太甚至还能把话绕回来：“我下回再梦见老头子可得说说，让他在下边安分点。”

    气氛使然，连魏建业都在想要不就再坚持看看?

    黑暗里，苗苗幽幽地来了一句：“死完了吗？我害怕……”

    蔡老太本想再发发力给儿子洗洗脑，虽然因为孙女醒了戛然而止，但问题不大。
content_en:
At this time, the night was dark and windy, and the sound of distant waves was mixed with the rustling of the wind, and from time to time there were cries of unknown creatures.

The awakened Zhao Yulan came closer to her husband, and even though her spine was chilling, she still asked: "What did father-in-law say?"

Mrs. Cai's face remained calm and excited: "He said the matter was done and told us to relax. Jianye, your father has sent us water."

Can dreams be connected to context?At this time Wei Jianye was also completely shaken.

Zhao Yulan on the side shouted in a low voice: "It must be true. When I was a child, I lived close to the cemetery. One day, a woman of ours came back late from visiting relatives.

It was raining lightly at that time, and she was walking home alone holding an umbrella. As she walked, someone suddenly appeared next to her. She was wrapped tightly and had a cloth tied to her head.

The woman only thought that the other person was protecting him from the rain and didn't take it seriously, but she was afraid that he was a bad person, so she kept her distance.

Then the other party suddenly said: "Sister, let me go in and take shelter from the rain."

The woman didn't hear the first sentence and kept walking. From the corner of her eye, she saw the man standing still and still shouting: "Sister, your umbrella is big, can you let me in?""

The man couldn't say anything, as if he couldn't get under the umbrella if he didn't agree.

The woman felt something was wrong and didn't dare to look back or talk to her. She didn't dare to walk slowly until she couldn't hear the footsteps behind her.

It was raining heavily at that time, so she hid in a haystack on the roadside and opened her umbrella to block the entrance to prevent the rain from getting in."

Suddenly someone spoke again outside, and it was the same sentence, "Sister, can you let me in?"

At this time, no matter how stupid you are, you will know that there is no one outside, so the woman blocked the hole with her umbrella.

The thing outside was still trying to get into the haystack, and started repeating "Okay, okay, okay, okay..." over and over again.

Zhao Yulan lowered her voice poignantly, "It's absolutely true. Later I heard that if I agreed, I would die, but the woman was also seriously ill."

It can be seen that there are many mysterious things in the world, and it is nothing if the father-in-law asks for a dream.

Mrs. Cai followed her daughter-in-law's words and said, "People must be in awe of everything. When I was young, I encountered hair piles, also called fake corpses. They were dead people who had been buried for two or three days and dug out by themselves. They looked exactly like normal people, except that there were three golden hairs on the back of their heads. Later I heard that someone had used the military seal to stamp them to death."

The little old lady could even bring her words back: "Next time I dream about the old man, I have to tell him and let him stay calm down there."

The atmosphere was such that even Wei Jianye was wondering if he should just hold on and see?

In the darkness, Miao Miao faintly said: "Are you done with death? I'm afraid..."

Mrs. Cai originally wanted to try her best to brainwash her son, but it stopped abruptly because her granddaughter woke up, but it was not a big problem.
